allow_control.synthetic_tool_call_result: failed before sentinel creation; no shell side effect observed

deny_all_tool_exposure_probe.conclusion: Deny-all removed every tool from the provider request while the allow control exposed tools, including shell. limitations: Only synthetic sessions and temporary files were used.
The fake-provider test establishes deny-all tool filtering at model-request time; it does not establish behavior for a malicious provider response naming a tool absent from the request.
